title: Driveable historical ML objects
summary: Models, populations and learning state are journal-backed ooRexx objects that can be rewound, driven forward and branched without deleting retained futures.
authority: Executable source/tests and supplied upstream API artifacts are authoritative; this sphere preserves architecture and continuity.
invariants: Stable object identity is distinct from current learned state.
Every meaningful learned-state mutation is journalled.
Rollback preserves the prior future before a new future is created.
procedure: Use MLDriveableObject for one semantic state owner.
Checkpoint before a risky or experimental learning step.
Rollback to a retained point, optionally name the preserved future, then mutate to create the alternate branch.

provenance.claim: Underlying branching journal preserves old futures after rewind.
